title: MCP server implementing the ADR 0012 alpha surface
objective: workctx mcp serve exposes the exact ADR 0012 tool surface over stdio with the official MCP Python SDK: 11 read tools, 6 approval-gated mutation tools, read-only resources, structured errors reusing the CLI diagnostic codes, strict context scoping, and integration tests.
business_value: MCP is the model-neutral boundary that lets any supported agent operate a context (UC-006); the surface is a versioned public contract from day one (risk R-017).
scope: Implement src/workctx/mcp/: a stdio server bound to one context root, registering exactly the ADR 0012 tools with explicit input/output JSON Schemas carrying schema_version 1

Read tools (context_info, workspace_validate, search, ref_show, ref_related, ref_trace, context_pack, task_list, task_show, inbox_list, audit_summary) delegating to the integrated engines' public APIs; Wave 4 dependents (task enrichment, draft_save) return the structured NOT-IMPLEMENTED error per ADR 0012 sequencing

Mutation tools (artifact_register, proposal_validate, transaction_dry_run, transaction_apply, index_rebuild, draft_save) requiring approved: true and failing structurally without it; draft_save is NOT-IMPLEMENTED until WP-420
Structured errors: map engine failures to the CLI diagnostic codes and error categories; no raw tracebacks or secret-looking values cross the boundary
Read-only resources: canonical entities by workctx:// URI and the context configuration, serialized from canonical files
Context scoping: every tool call verifies the bound context; cross-context URIs are refused (denial tests per doc-07 MCP section); no tool can escape the context root
Wire workctx mcp serve [--context] as the single CLI entry point for the server (narrow, explicitly granted cli.py edit)

Enable the mcp extra for development: add the mcp dependency group wiring to pyproject.toml dev group or CI extras (narrow, explicitly granted; D-016 lifts when your code imports the SDK) and keep the runtime dependency optional (extra), with a clear unavailable-dependency error when the extra is absent
Document the surface, versioning policy, and client configuration in docs/reference/mcp.md
non_goals: No tools beyond ADR 0012; no MCP prompts; no external writes of any kind
No agent client configuration generation (WP-320's seam is finalized by the lead after you integrate)
No engine changes anywhere — a needed API gap is a coordination request
No transports beyond stdio in the alpha
deliverables: MCP server package implementing the ADR 0012 surface with integration tests against the official SDK
workctx mcp serve CLI entry point; dev/CI wiring for the mcp extra
acceptance_criteria: Tool discovery lists exactly the ADR 0012 surface with schema_version 1 input/output schemas
Each implemented read tool returns engine-faithful structured data on a fixture workspace; NOT-IMPLEMENTED tools return the structured placeholder, not absence
Every mutation tool fails structurally without approved: true and succeeds with it (transaction_apply verified end-to-end against a fixture proposal)
Cross-context URI and path-escape attempts are refused on every tool (denial tests)
Errors carry diagnostic codes; no tracebacks or secret-looking values in any tool result (negative test)
Server runs and shuts down cleanly over stdio in an SDK-client integration test; absent mcp extra yields the clear unavailable-dependency error
The full validation gate passes with the extra enabled in dev/CI
security_constraints: No external writes; no network beyond stdio; evidence and workspace content cross the boundary only through the engines' sanitized outputs
pyproject.toml and ci.yml edits are limited to enabling the mcp extra for dev/CI — any other change there is forbidden
stop_conditions: An engine API gap for an ADR 0012 tool (coordination request)
The mcp SDK pin (mcp[cli]>=2,<3) failing to resolve or breaking the gate on any supported platform
Any needed change to the ADR 0012 surface itself (that is an ADR revision, not a worker decision)
